job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a Boston Retirement System RFP for actuarial and consulting services, not the TMRS global custody RFP. It does not provide the requested evaluation criteria or percentage weights.
quotes: Request for Proposal Actuarial and Consulting Services for Pension Benefits Boston Retirement System September 12, 2022

The Boston Retirement System (“BRS”), hereby requests sealed proposals from interested and qualified actuary firms (“Offerors”) to provide actuarial and consulting services including, but not limited to providing a biennial valuation.
The evaluation committee shall assign a rating of “highly advantageous”, “advantageous”, or “unacceptable” to each criterion.
